comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts a gripper opening stop; PR-2013 squares a racked two-rail gantry against paired end stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Both are robot-hardware tasks with bimanual force coordination, but the candidate counterholds concentric screw/nut tools while PR-2013 advances both beam ends together to avoid rail binding.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked target angle retained through three cycles; PR-2013 requires both carriage gaps at most 0.05 mm, rail seating, stillness, and release.
comparison.reason: PR-2013 tests synchronized linear squaring; it has no adjustable fastener, locking reaction, or functional retention cycle.
